failure_modes: retrieved memory treated as used memory
invariants: No private hidden reasoning is requested or stored.
Every explanation distinguishes recorded fact from reconstruction.
Trace data is minimized and scope-bound.
procedure: Capture structured operational events without private chain-of-thought.
Link decisions, evidence, tools, policies, alternatives, and state transitions.
Reconstruct gaps as labeled inference, never recorded fact.
Emit reproducible reports and machine-readable graphs.

confidence: may adjust only through declared evidence and method
knowledge: may add or revise typed records only with provenance
memory: no persistent memory write unless explicitly contracted and scope-bound
registry: may propose changes; canonical mutation requires admission and evidence
runtime: bounded by target orchestration, permissions, containment, and rollback

summary: Enumerate feasible alternatives available at a decision point and compare selected versus rejected agents, skills, tools, and plans by utility, risk, permissions, and uncertainty.
title: Alternative Path Analyzer
when_to_use: Use for costly, risky, failed, or repeatedly suboptimal decisions.
